# RIVAYAT Fashion

RIVAYAT is an independent Indian clothing storefront for fan jerseys, expressive layers, women’s edits and casual everyday fashion.

Canonical website: https://www.rivayat.shop/
Shop: https://www.rivayat.shop/shop
About the team: https://www.rivayat.shop/about
Shipping: https://www.rivayat.shop/shipping
Returns: https://www.rivayat.shop/returns-policy
Privacy: https://www.rivayat.shop/privacy
Contact: https://www.rivayat.shop/contact
Legal centre: https://www.rivayat.shop/legal

Product prices, stock, approved customer ratings and availability should be taken from each canonical product page. RIVAYAT does not represent independent fanwear as official club or team merchandise.
